notes.title: Infect Cam x indie.io – A New Partnership Begins!
notes.content:
[h3]We’re thrilled to officially announce that Infect Cam is joining forces with indie.io![/h3]
This partnership marks a huge milestone for our development journey, and we couldn't be more excited for what's ahead. With indie.io’s support, we'll be able to focus more on creating the best possible version of Infect Cam while they work their magic behind the scenes.

[h3]What is Infect Cam?[/h3]
Infect Cam is a story-driven survival horror game we’ve been developing with a deep passion for atmospheric tension and meaningful storytelling.
We started working on the game because we wanted to create something that blends psychological horror with player-driven exploration. From the very beginning, our community's feedback and excitement have kept us going—and we can’t wait to show you more.


[h3]Why indie.io?[/h3]
For those of you who may not know, working with a game publishing platform like indie.io greatly helps indie developers focus on game development while they handle all the behind-the-scenes magic.
From helping manage store pages to crafting marketing campaigns and even helping the game shine at both digital and live events, indie.io helps in all the aspects that indie developers often struggle with alone.

So why did we choose indie.io?

Because they’ve built a great reputation for helping indie games like ours reach more players. We’ve heard amazing things from other developers who’ve worked with them, and we knew they’d be the right team to help Infect Cam grow and thrive in today’s crowded market.

Check out the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio]indie.io Steam Publisher Page[/url] to discover more great indie games!

[h3]What’s Next?[/h3]
We have tons of exciting updates coming soon—new content, behind-the-scenes insights, and a few surprises we can’t wait to reveal.
Your continued support means the world to us, and we’re so excited to take this next step together with YOU.



🎯 Be sure to wishlist and follow Infect Cam right here on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3168930/Infect_Cam/]Steam[/url]
💬 Join our [url=https://discord.gg/839ZZPnYp5]Discord[/url] to be part of the conversation and get early news
📢 Follow us on [url=https://x.com/ravenholmint]social media[/url] to stay updated on everything Infect Cam

Thank you for being part of this journey.
This is just the beginning. 💥
